# DifferentiableNetworkMetrics

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Network science metrics (e.g., centrality, clustering, path length) reformulated as differentiable functions of the adjacency matrix, allowing backpropagation through topology. This bridges network theory and deep learning, enabling end-to-end training of topology-aware computing and neuromorphic substrates.
